sloka: उपाध्याय वचः श्रुत्वा स राजा पुरुषर्षभ ।अन्वियेष महाबुद्धिः पशुम् गोभिः सहस्रशः ॥१-६१-९॥
transliteration: upādhyāya vacaḥ śrutvā sa rājā puruṣarṣabha ।anviyeṣa mahābuddhiḥ paśum gobhiḥ sahasraśaḥ ॥1-61-9॥

translations.english: "O Best of men (Rama) hearing the words of the high priest, the highly intellectual king searched for a human victim in exchange for thousands of cows.
